thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate from streaming gateway observed. Aggregated errors across eu-west and us-central around 20:03 UTC. Initial spike at ~20:01. Affected endpoints: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Error breakdown: 502 gateway, 504 upstream timeout, client disconnects. Logs attached to alert.

oncall-sre: ACK. I'm taking this one, will triage.

sara: seeing a bunch of chunked encoding errors in gateway logs too. Example: `chunked: malformed frame` followed by `upstream reset`.

daniel: any recent deploys to gateway or runtime?

priya: no infra deploys in the last 2 hours. There was a runtime push to the streaming encoder service at 19:45 (commit c3f9b2e). Rolling back might be a quick mitigation.

chris: customer-support flagged 3 paying customers seeing persistent disconnects for streaming responses (they're seeing partial transcripts then stream ends). We should estimate impact.

oncall-sre: steps: 1) gather quick metrics (5xx rate per region) 2) check gateway config (keepalive, timeouts) 3) try hotfix: revert encoder or enable fallback to chunked passthrough 4) notify customers + handoff if needed.

incident-bot: metrics snapshot: 5xx rate spiked x12 over baseline, p50 latency backpressure increased. Region map: eu-west 62% of errors, us-central 28%, ap-south 10%.

priya: I'm going to temporarily enable the gateway fallback route to route streaming to standby pool (non-optimized encoder) — this will increase CPU cost but should reduce malformed chunking. Applying now.

devex-bot: command run: `kubectl patch svc streaming-gateway -p '{"spec":{"annotations":{"routing/fallback":"true"}}}'` — patch accepted.

chris: contacting the 3 customers now with a short note: "We're investigating intermittent streaming disconnects, mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with ETA."

customer-support: templates: please include request-id and example timestamps; ask customers to collect `client-request-id` headers if possible.

oncall-sre: after enabling fallback: 5xx rate dropped ~60% in eu-west within 3m. Still seeing some 504s for long-running streams.

priya: starting a revert of the encoder service to the previous tag (c3f9b2e -> c3f9b2d). Rolling restart on one pod for canary.

priya: canary pod log snippet: ```
2026-03-01T20:06:12Z encoder[pid=47]: accepted chunked frame size=4096
2026-03-01T20:06:13Z encoder[pid=47]: sent chunked frame to runtime
2026-03-01T20:06:15Z encoder[pid=47]: upstream reset by peer
```

daniel: curious if client cancellations are due to our drop or client timeouts. Are clients seeing FINs? We should check gateway TCP logs / ELB metrics.

oncall-sre: capturing tcpdump on affected gateway pod now. Also increasing gateway upstream timeout from 30s -> 60s as a temporary measure.

incident-bot: config change recorded: gateway upstream timeout=60s (applied by oncall-sre).

chris: customer update sent: "We've applied a mitigation routing streaming traffic to a standby encoder pool and increased gateway timeouts. We're rolling a safe revert of a recent encoder change; we expect recovery within ~20-30 minutes."

sara: tcpdump shows client FIN from IPs associated with our mobile SDK after partial frames. There's a cluster of retransmits before the FIN. Could be a malformed chunk boundary triggering client abort.

priya: the canary revert looks good so far — no chunk parse errors in the reverted pod. Promoting revert to 50% of streaming pods.

devex-bot: deploy command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/encoder --selector=tier=streaming --record` — rollout started.

oncall-sre: after rollout to 50%, 5xxs down to ~15% of spike level. Latency p95 improving. Still monitoring.

daniel: let's enable additional request-level retries for non-idempotent streaming? Probably not safe. Instead add best-effort reconnect guidance to SDKs. cc @devex-bot to open a docs note.

devex-bot: opened doc draft: "Streaming reconnect guidance" PR #452 in devex.

customer-support: one customer replied: they saw partial responses but no data corruption; they can implement client retry if we publish guidance. They've accepted the temporary impact for now.

oncall-sre: preparing a postmortem stub. Early impact: 3 enterprise customers affected with degraded streaming continuity for up to 18 minutes. Root cause (initial): bad encoder change causing malformed chunk boundaries under specific packetization patterns causing client aborts + gateway timeouts amplifying failures.

sara: follow-ups: 1) add unit/integration tests for chunk boundary handling, 2) add canary traffic with higher variance of packet sizes, 3) add alerting for sudden spike in `chunked: malformed frame` errors.

priya: adding a regression test in encoder repo now. Will link PR in postmortem.

oncall-sre: handoff — I'm paged out at 20:30 UTC. @chris will take on-call continuity for the next hour. Please escalate if errors rebound.

chris: ACK — monitoring dashboards + log tailing. I'll coordinate final customer closure.

incident-bot: incident resolved: service stability restored at 20:19 UTC, mitigation completed. Follow-up: full postmortem with timeline, impact, RCA, and actions.

chris: creating incident ticket INC-2026-045 and will ping infra for a blameless RCA.

customer-support: final customer note queued for sending after postmortem ready.

oncall-sre: thanks team. Good mitigation rhythm. :thumbsup:

priya: PR #789 added test + revert note. Will add postmortem links once ticket exists.

devex-bot: reminder: add SDK reconnect guidance to changelog and push an alertable metric for client FIN rate.

chris: closing thread for live triage; will reopen if any regressions.
